Callout.Name: Assault - Punch Injury
Callout.Message: Person punched outside a bar, face bleeding.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, suspect gone, nose likely broken.

Script.Line: One punch. That is all it was, one punch.
He walked off towards the taxi rank.
My teeth feel loose. Is that normal, teeth feeling loose?

Callout.Patient: He just hit me. I did not say anything to him.

Lines.Approach: One punch, one face, and the suspect is already down the road.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
